import json, tomllib, re, pathlib

in_py = pathlib.Path('/inputs/pyproject.toml')
in_tpl = pathlib.Path('/inputs/devcontainer.json')
out = pathlib.Path('/work/devcontainer.json')

# Read inputs
py_data = tomllib.loads(in_py.read_text(encoding='utf-8'))
proj_name = py_data['project']['name']
slug = proj_name.lower().replace(' ', '-').replace('_', '-')

tpl_text = in_tpl.read_text(encoding='utf-8')
repl_text = tpl_text.replace('{{PROJECT_NAME}}', proj_name).replace('{{PROJECT_SLUG}}', slug)
obj = json.loads(repl_text)

# Modify required fields
exts = obj['customizations']['vscode']['extensions']
exts.extend([
    'ms-python.python',
    'ms-python.vscode-pylance',
    'charliermarsh.ruff'
])

settings = obj['customizations']['vscode']['settings']
settings['python.defaultInterpreterPath'] = '.venv/bin/python'
settings['[python]'] = {
    'editor.defaultFormatter': 'charliermarsh.ruff',
    'editor.codeActionsOnSave': {
        'source.organizeImports': 'explicit'
    }
}

obj['postCreateCommand'] = 'rm -rf .venv && uv sync && uv run /opt/post_install.py'

# Write output as valid JSON UTF-8
out.write_text(json.dumps(obj, ensure_ascii=False, indent=2) + '\n', encoding='utf-8')

# Validate JSON output can be parsed
json.loads(out.read_text(encoding='utf-8'))

print('WROTE', str(out), 'project=', proj_name, 'slug=', slug)
print('extensions_count', len(obj['customizations']['vscode']['extensions']))
